annotation.title_clean: Chair's summary – Second 2025 session of the GGE on LAWS
annotation.title_en: Chair's summary – Second 2025 session of the GGE on LAWS
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Chairperson of the CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS (H.E. Robert in den Bosch)
annotation.summary_en: Chair's summary of the September 2025 CCW Group of Governmental Experts session on lethal autonomous weapons systems. It records discussion of the five-box rolling text covering LAWS characterization, IHL application, prohibitions and regulations, lifecycle measures, and accountability, notes divergences, especially over "context-appropriate human judgement and control", and sets the way forward to the 2026 Review Conference.
key_provisions_or_claims: Rolling text characterizes LAWS by critical functions of selecting and engaging targets without human operator intervention.
Proposed two-tier approach: prohibitions plus regulations ensuring compliance with IHL.
Context-appropriate human judgement and control remains the main point of divergence.
States should conduct legal reviews, testing, bias mitigation and training across the LAWS lifecycle.
Responsibility and accountability cannot be transferred to machines; report due to 2026 Review Conference.
